data.raw_text: LOOK: Senator Lito Lapid handed out relief goods to affected residents in five flood-hit towns in Pampanga on Saturday, July 26. In partnership with the DSWD, he distributed food packs to 4,000 families in Sasmuan, Minalin, Sto. Tomas, Macabebe, and Masantol. Lapid said he would seek President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s help to find a permanent solution to the decades-long flooding problem in the province. He stressed the need for unity and proposed dredging and desilting rivers as key measures to prevent future disasters. (Contributed Photos)
